wallpaper.description: Image used as both the desktop and lock screen background

wallpaperDir.description: Folder shown in the wallpaper picker in Settings

barStyle.description: Look of the bar: the full strip, a floating capsule, three islands, or a solid bar with rounded screen corners

browser.description: Command used to open web searches

browserClass.description: Window class to focus after opening a search (empty to skip)

privateFlag.description: Flag that opens a private window, used by !!bang

defaultBang.description: Bang used when a query has none, e.g. g or ddg

bangs.description: Extra bangs: key -> { name, url } where %s in url is the query

privateUrl.description: Used by !! instead of a private window, e.g. a temporary-chat URL

icon.description: Path or icon name shown in results

enabled.description: Suggest words while typing in any app that supports input methods

addSpace.description: Put a space after a completed word

learn.description: Rank words you complete often first

excludeApps.description: Comma separated window classes where autocomplete stays off (terminals by default)

nightLightGamma.description: Screen brightness of the filter in percent

clock24h.description: Show a 24-hour clock in the bar, quick settings and lock screen

trayVisible.description: How many tray icons show in the bar before the rest fold behind the arrow

trayHidden.description: Ids of tray apps that never show in the bar, separated by |

dnd.description: Do not disturb: notifications skip the toast and go straight to the panel

popupSeconds.description: How long a toast stays when the app does not set a time

enabled.description: Show the bottom dock on empty workspaces and at the bottom screen edge

screenOffAfterMinutes.description: Turn off displays after inactivity; 0 disables this

autoSave.description: Also save each screenshot as a file; it is always copied to the clipboard

ocrLanguages.description: Tesseract languages used by Extract text, joined with + (for example eng+ara)

autoPaste.description: Paste the picked item into the focused window (needs wtype); false only copies it

enabled.description: Write the Hyprland options changed in Settings. Off leaves Hyprland entirely to the hand-written config

accentBorder.description: The active window border takes the shell's accent colour

blurLayers.description: Hyprland blurs what is behind the bar and panels (layer rules for the shell's windows)

values.description: Hyprland options changed in Settings, by name (for example general:gaps_in)

recentColors.description: Colours picked in Settings, newest first

monitors.description: Monitor name -> mode and scale chosen in Settings, applied when the shell starts

disabled.description: Ids of the shell's own apps (apps/<App>/app.json) that are switched off
